content_text: jared is the man and knows his shit need more ppl tossing up unit economics models, ways to lay out a biz and getting comfortable with whats not disclosed, assumptions, confidence intervals, the unknown unknowns stuff I learned by 30, but shouldve, and couldve learned at 25 this is a dogshit SIRI LTV from 10+ years ago, I'm not a TMT analyst so I can guarantee this is like a pastiche of staring at 10 sell side models and trying to back into "how the fuck do u model this" and sell side, their shit never ties w/ one another on these types of breakouts, so ur clueless but theres way more young-wannabe-tmt types on here, than older veteran-tmt-types breaking down the game for them. mfs gatekeeping behind a $9.99 substack as if that shit won't buy u 60% of a Jimmy John's italian sub....sandwiches are $15 now homeboy, ur unit economics dont work but this format...breaking shit all the way down into FCF/user, 5-10 years out, and then rolling that up into an EV and discounting back u can work with that, like, if u get that right...thats prob the way u would model with the highest level of analytical rigor fcf per user, per unit, per store, per whatever rather than, starting from top of the IS and just flowing down the consolidateds here u can put thought into what items scale and what dont...fixed/variable, et cetera. so just have a Master twtr excel model, screenshot or scribble this into an empty tab, circle back when u have time and flesh it out into something handcrafted ur gonna end up doing a lot of shit like this regardless so instead of "I'm lost" just ask Claude 10000 times until ur shit works. good luck and FITFO - figure it the fuck out...u, claude, grok, gemini, and chatgpt against the world.
